_note: The human-editable source of truth for what tools/stripe-setup.sh creates in Stripe. Amounts are in cents. Prices are addressed everywhere by lookup_key, never by price id, so re-creating them in another Stripe account changes nothing in the code. Change an amount here, run the script again, and it creates a new price, moves the lookup key onto it and deactivates the old one — existing subscribers keep the price they bought. Cap numbers live in app_config (limits.plans), not here; trial_days must match the billing.trial_days seed in supabase/migrations/20260904200000_billing.sql.
_tax_code_note: Stripe product tax code. txcd_10103000 = Software as a service (SaaS), personal use. Required by Managed Payments (Stripe as merchant of record, on by default for new accounts) and used by Stripe Tax if that is ever switched on instead.
_trial_note: Applied to the ANNUAL price only, with a card taken up front — the free tier is the monthly plan's trial. The function reads app_config.billing.trial_days, not this; keep the two equal.
_founding_note: Disabled for new launch purchases by the GTM plan. Historical offer: $10 off the first year for the first 200 accounts. Honor existing purchases and explicit promises before changing the live coupon. This source setting does not disable a live coupon; the function's own switch is the app_config row billing.founding, which must be the string true for the coupon to be shown or applied at all, and which nothing seeds. Leave that row absent AND delete the coupon in the Dashboard to close the offer. A fixed-id coupon rather than a promotion code, because nobody types it — the function applies it to every yearly checkout for as long as Stripe says the coupon is valid, and Stripe's own max_redemptions closes the offer. Amounts are immutable once a coupon exists: to change the offer, delete the coupon in the Dashboard and run this script again. To END the offer, just delete it — the paywall stops showing it within five minutes and checkout goes to full price. Note that a coupon and Checkout's promo-code box are mutually exclusive, so while this exists the yearly checkout has no 'enter a code' field; monthly keeps one.

products.name: Spotter Plus
products._description_note: Pushed to the live Stripe product by ensureProduct on every run and shown on the Checkout page the customer buys from, so it is customer-facing copy and follows the same rule as the paywall: no unlimited AI and no numeric allowance the cost controls cannot deliver. Numbers of record: design/gtm/ALLOWANCES.md section 3.
products.description: An unlimited library and 20 full video reads a month, with 300 coaching answers from Pumpy, 100 explanations and swaps and 10 uploads. Saving from a caption, logging, your plan and your progress are always free.

products._enabled_note: Off on purpose. Spotter sells one paid tier; pro exists in the schema and the cap table as the price-raise valve. Set enabled to true and run the script again the day it is sold — nothing in the function changes.
products.name: Spotter Pro
products.description: Everything in Plus, with the daily ceilings raised again.

_events_note: Every one of these calls the same syncStripeCustomer, so the list is about which changes are worth a round trip, not about which handler runs. invoice.created is deliberately absent: subscribing to it means a slow response can delay invoice finalisation by up to 72 hours.
